mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_id, quantity, selected, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, selected, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected = 1
